ca2/obj_dieppe <# team 1>German</# team 1> <# team 2>British</# team 2> onspawn.moveout * Dieppe Raid
# new 3-stage localizations (some overlap)
# victory1 requires completion of all 3 objectives victory1 * Allied Victory! Allied raiders have pushed the German defenders out of town.
# victory2 requires the Allies fail to achieve objective phase 3 before round timer runs out victory2 * Axis Victory! German forces have successfully defended the town from Allied raiders.
roundstop * This round is over! playarea * This is the edge of the play area, you cannot leave the play area
#Phase 1 functions and messages
ukspawn1 * Get to the outer bunker lines and open the attack into the town!
# bunkerlines 1a and 1b are Allied capture objectives for phase 1 only bunkerline1a * Bunker A bunkerline1b * Bunker B
# minefields are always active minefield * minefield youcapon * You are capturing the beach bunkerline! alliedcapon * Allied forces are capturing the beach bunkers! alliedcapoff * Axis forces have re-taken their beach bunkers! onspawn.1.1.1 = Get to one of the bunker lines and secure the beachhead! onspawn.2.1.1 = Push the Allied raiders into the sea! bunkerline1afalling = Allied soldiers are securing the western beach bunkers! bunkerline1bfalling = Allied soldiers are securing the eastern beach bunkers! bunkerline1a.1.1.1 = Capture this line of bunkers bunkerline1a.2.1.1 = Defend this area bunkerline1b.1.1.1 = Capture this line of bunkers bunkerline1b.2.1.1 = Defend this area bunkerline1asecure = Allied forces have captured the western beach bunker lines! bunkerline1bsecure = Allied forces have captured the eastern beach bunker lines!
# Phase 2 functions and messages
ukspawn2 * Get to the enemy HQ and move the Germans back to the rear of town! onspawn.1.1.2 = Work through the town and capture the Enemy HQ overlooking the beaches. onspawn.2.1.2 = Defend the HQ position from being overrun by Allied forces! # HQ is the "bunker" or allied phase 2 capture objective GHQ * Capture Objective youcapon * You are capturing the enemy HQ! alliedcapon * Allied forces are capturing the German HQ! alliedcapoff * Axis forces have defended their HQ position!
# the following 2 messages are broadcast to Axis but not Allies HQfalling.2.1.2 = Allied forces are capturing the HQ position! HQsecure.2.1.2 = Allied solidiers have captured the enemy HQ and infiltrated the town!
# the following 2 messages are broadcast to Allies but not Axis HQfalling.1.1.2 = Allied soldiers have infiltrated the German HQ position HQsecure.1.1.2 = Allied solidiers have captured the enemy HQ and are moving through the town
# Phase 3 functions and messages
ukspawn3 * Move through the town and eliminate the German defenders!
Town Cap * Capture Objective
# victory1 requires completion of all 3 objectives victory1 * Allied Victory! Allied raiders have pushed the German defenders out of town.
# victory2 requires the Allies fail to achieve objective phase 3 before round timer runs out victory2 * Axis Victory! German forces have successfully defended the town from Allied raiders.
ukspawn3 * Get to the town capture objective and complete capture of the town! onspawn.1.1.2 = Capture the last objective at the back of town. onspawn.2.1.2 = Defend the last objective from being overrun by Allied forces! # Town Cap is the "bunker" or allied phase 3 capture objective Town Cap * Capture Objective youcapon * You are capturing the last objective! alliedcapon * Allied forces are capturing the town! alliedcapoff * Axis forces have defended the town!
# the following 2 messages are broadcast to both sides townfalling.2.1.2 = Allied forces are capturing the last objective! townsecure.2.1.2 = Allied solidiers have captured the last objective and won the round! true The Allies raid Dieppe township. 30 true true true 1 7 52292.90 2996679.50 0.00 dieppe 2 2 ? 2
